title: Band-9 Samples: Has a neighbour ever helped you? [Why/why not?]
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 14 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 4 Test 3 question: “Has a neighbour ever helped you? [Why/why not?]” Sample 1: Yes Female Male Absolutely! I recall a time when I was new to the neighbourhood, and I had trouble finding my way around. My neighbour, who was familiar with the area, spared no effort in providing me with directions and advice on local amenities. Their guidance proved instrumental in helping me acclimate to my new surroundings more rapidly, contributing to a smoother transition for me and my family. Sample 2: Yes Female Male Most definitely! I once faced a plumbing issue in my house late at night, which resulted in a minor flood. My neighbour, who happened to be an experienced plumber, came over immediately after I called them. They managed to quickly ascertain the problem and fix it, preventing any further damage. Their expertise and prompt action were invaluable, and I am truly appreciative of their assistance in that emergency situation. Sample 3: Yes Female Male Indeed, I’ve been fortunate enough to have very supportive neighbours. One particular instance that comes to mind is when I accidentally locked myself out of my house. My neighbour, noticing my predicament, kindly offered to lend me a hand. He managed to contact a reliable locksmith, who promptly arrived and resolved the issue. I was extremely grateful for his timely assistance and neighbourly concern. Sample 4: Yes Female Male Absolutely! A few months ago, I was out of town, and an unexpected storm hit my area. My vigilant neighbour noticed a broken window in my house and promptly contacted me. He then took the initiative to temporarily fix it, preventing any potential water damage. His prompt action and resourcefulness truly demonstrated a sense of solidarity. Sample 5: Yes Female Male Absolutely, my neighbour has been a tremendous help during a difficult time in my life. When I fell ill with the flu last winter, she went above and beyond by offering to care for my dog and run errands for me. Her compassionate nature and willingness to help truly made a significant difference in my recovery and overall well-being. Sample 6: No Female Male Honestly, I’ve never had the opportunity to receive help from any of my neighbours. I attribute this to the rather introverted nature of our community. We all respect each other’s privacy, and our interactions are mostly limited to polite greetings or small talk when we cross paths. Sample 7: No Female Male To be honest, I’ve never experienced any assistance from a neighbour. I believe this is because I’ve always been self-reliant and independent. When I face difficulties, I tend to seek solutions on my own or rely on my close friends and family, rather than turning to my neighbours. Sample 8: No Female Male In my case, I’ve never had the occasion to be helped by a neighbour. This might be because I’ve always lived in fairly secure and well-maintained apartment complexes. Any issues that arise are typically handled by the building management, so there’s rarely a need to seek help from those living nearby. Sample 9: No Female Male Unfortunately, I have never been on the receiving end of help from a neighbour. I reckon this is due to the fast-paced lifestyle that most of us lead nowadays. Everyone seems to be constantly occupied with their own commitments, leaving little room for building deeper connections with neighbours and lending a helping hand. Sample 10: No Female Male I must admit that I’ve never been in a circumstance where a neighbour has come to my aid. One reason could be that all my neighbours and I have well-established support systems, such as family and friends, who we turn to when we need help. As a result, we rarely need to seek assistance from each other.
